messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — planning a short webinar + OSS refapp post around our new local-bench flow. Looking to sync on messaging, benchmark narrative, and inbound routing. :rocket:
Jake: I'm in. Do we want a data-driven bench (latency/cost) or a feature-focused demo?
Sam: both. Marketing wants headlines: 'Xx lower cost' + 'Y ms median latency' — but we should avoid absolutes unless reproducible.
Lee: can build a tiny benchmark script and a Docker image. Suggest using a small dataset and 1k-token profiles to keep numbers realistic.
Maria: timeline — draft copy by Mon, recording Wed, launch post + webinar Thurs. @Jake can you draft the post + tweet thread? @Lee can you drop benchmark commands and sample outputs?
Jake: yes. Draft tweet thread here — feel free to edit:
"We built a tiny refapp that shows how to run local inference with Redwood Optimize to save 3x on per-token costs while keeping 95% of latency. Demo + guide -> <landing link>"
Sam: re: numbers — be explicit with testbed: model, quantization, hardware, batch size. We'll include a table in the blog.
Lee: sample command (for bench):
```
# run perf
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app redwood/bench:0.1 \
  --model local/redwood-7b-q4 --requests sample_inputs.json --batch 4
```
Outputs will include p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec.
Nina: legal/brand - need to sign off on claims and the logo usage. I'll route the blog to legal by Tue.
Maria: inbound — we'll gate webinar with HubSpot form, tag leads with 'refapp-bench-2026' and route to 'dev-sdr' queue. @Jake please add UTM and short landing copy.
Jake: putting draft landing copy in Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/... — TL;DR: 'Try the refapp — reproducible benchmark + quickstart in 10 minutes.'
DeployBot: calendar event created: Webinar — Refapp Bench & Tutorial — Wed 10am PT. Invite: https://calendar.google.com/...
Sam: for the webinar demo, plan to run the bench live but prewarm caches and show pre-recorded run for larger test to avoid flakiness.
Maria: perfect. Action items: Jake draft post + landing, Lee bench image + commands, Sam demo script, Nina legal review. I'll own promotion plan (newsletter, community posts, twitter). We'll reconvene Mon 9am. :calendar:
Jake: noted, will deliver Monday morning.
Lee: will push bench image + example outputs to the doc.
Nina: will start legal review today.
